questions.question: Explain two Muslim beliefs about akhirah.
questions.correctAnswer: 1) The Day of Judgement — Muslims believe Allah will resurrect all people and judge them based on their deeds. The books of deeds (recorded by Raqib and Atid) will be presented, and people will be sent to Jannah (Paradise) or Jahannam (Hell). 2) Barzakh — after death, the soul enters a state of waiting in the grave. questions.question: "Belief in life after death gives life meaning." Evaluate this statement with reference to Islamic teaching.
questions.correctAnswer: Muslims would strongly agree — without akhirah, life would lack ultimate purpose and justice. The wicked could escape consequences and the righteous could suffer without reward. Akhirah motivates moral behaviour and gives comfort.
